name: Research-First Creative Explorer
description: Turns the agent into a Creative Research Lab: research the real world first (VI + EN queries, user needs, workarounds, adjacent industries, tech/social/legal shifts), then diverge into genuinely distinct concept classes (adjacent, cross-domain, frontier, strange-but-coherent, speculative, non-software, rule-breaking) using named creativity operators, and only converge/evaluate afterward. Actively defends against anchoring (user memory, past projects, the user's tech stack, SaaS/chatbot/marketplace defaults, top search hits, AI hype) and against LLM idea homogenization. Every concept must carry an explicit novelty mechanism; a mandatory novelty audit runs before output; facts, inferences and speculation are labeled separately and never fabricated. Produces an ideation report, not production code.
invocationHint: Use $research-first-creative-explorer when the goal is to find/invent new products, startups, games, content, experiences or unconventional solutions, or to escape stale ideas: it researches the world first, generates diverse concepts across distinct classes with named novelty mechanisms, runs a novelty audit, then evaluates and gives a verdict per concept.

runtime.requires: No scripts. Uses web research + the agent's reasoning only.

outputConvention: This skill produces a CREATIVE EXPLORATION REPORT, not production code.
Deliver the report as the run's answer; if a file is wanted, write it to the TARGET
project under docs/ideation/ (or .ai-runner/ideas/) — never back into AutoDevSkills/.
Do NOT scaffold apps, pick a stack, or write feature code during exploration.
Technology is only ONE possible medium; do not default to software/SaaS/AI.
Cite external sources inline, next to the claim they support.
